use_case: Predictive maintenance for non-safety plant equipment: anomaly detection and remaining-life estimates for balance-of-plant pumps, motors, and transformers at Stations A and B
business_owner: Fleet engineering director (with each station Maintenance Rule coordinator)
vendor_or_model: Predictive maintenance analytics SaaS vendor (SYS-N9); vendor machine learning models trained on fleet history
data_categories: Plant process data from the business DMZ replicas (vibration, temperature, current, pressure); work order history from the WMS; no personal information
human_in_the_loop: Condition (since 2026-09-15): a system engineer reviews every alert and approves any work request; the model never changes schedules, setpoints, or Maintenance Rule status
applicable_laws: 10 CFR 50.65(a)(1), (a)(3), (a)(4), (b)(2)(iii) (C-NUCLEAR-S04); 10 CFR 73.58(b)-(c) (C-NUCLEAR-S03); 10 CFR 73.54 boundary (outbound-only data from the replicas; no path to CDAs) (C-NUCLEAR-R01); group AI Standard
status: In production (pilot, 2 stations) with conditions; expansion to Station C and to safety-related equipment not approved

use_case: Generative AI engineering assistant for drafting reports, procedures, and literature searches
business_owner: Engineering and Radiation Services chief engineer
vendor_or_model: Enterprise license of a commercial large language model (no training on group data)
data_categories: Non-SGI engineering text; client project information that is not cyber security sensitive
consequential_decision_category: None directly; re-tier to Safety/CI if used in safety-related calculations or design documents
human_in_the_loop: Engineer of record reviews and owns every output; prohibited in safety-related calculations until the QA procedure is issued
applicable_laws: Client QA requirements (10 CFR Part 50, Appendix B, flowed down by contract); 10 CFR 73.22 (no SGI); Part 810 (no controlled technology to the tool); POL-05 4.4, 4.6

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant for office productivity
vendor_or_model: Same enterprise language model tenant as AI-002
data_categories: Internal documents classified Internal; no regulated information (POL-05 4.4)
human_in_the_loop: User reviews outputs; no decisions about people

use_case: SOC alert triage and anomaly scoring
vendor_or_model: EDR and SIEM vendors' built-in machine learning
data_categories: Security telemetry from business systems (user names, device names, network activity); never CDA data
consequential_decision_category: None directly; outputs can start investigations of individuals
human_in_the_loop: Analysts decide every escalation; scores never disable accounts automatically except for confirmed malware
applicable_laws: POL-03; state employee monitoring notice laws (each state); group AI Standard

use_case: Dosimetry anomaly flagging: flags unusual dose readings and possible dosimeter faults for health physicist review
vendor_or_model: Model built by the laboratory on historical processing data
data_categories: Dosimeter readings, processing parameters, monitored individual identifiers (personal information)
consequential_decision_category: None directly; dose results can affect a worker's ability to continue radiation work
human_in_the_loop: A health physicist reviews every flag; the model never changes an assigned dose
applicable_laws: 10 CFR 20.1501(d) and NVLAP quality system (C-NUCLEAR-S08); 20.2106 records; customer contracts; state breach laws (personal information)

use_case: Outage craft staffing match: ranks candidates for outage craft and technician roles from resumes and qualification records
business_owner: Engineering and Radiation Services outage staffing director
data_categories: Resumes, work history, qualifications, location (personal information of applicants)
human_in_the_loop: Proposed: recruiters review every ranked list; the model may not reject anyone
applicable_laws: Title VII disparate impact; state AI employment laws where candidates reside (for example Colorado SB26-189 from 2027-01-01, Illinois HB 3773, California Civil Rights Council ADS rules and CPPA ADMT rules); FCRA if the vendor supplies consumer report data (N56-R02)
status: Proposed; not approved until a bias audit and notice process are in place

use_case: Waste container imaging classifier: flags prohibited items (for example free liquids or sealed containers) in radiographic scans of incoming waste packages
vendor_or_model: Vendor computer vision model on the scanning system, tuned on division images
data_categories: Radiographic images of waste packages; manifest data
human_in_the_loop: A radwaste technician reviews every scan; the classifier can add a hold but cannot release a package
applicable_laws: License conditions and waste acceptance criteria at each facility; DOT hazmat rules for shipments; group AI Standard
status: Pilot at the second facility; Florida deployment not approved

use_case: Driver safety scoring from transport telematics
data_categories: Driving events, location, driver identity (personal information)
human_in_the_loop: Supervisor reviews any score used in coaching or discipline; drivers can dispute
applicable_laws: State employee monitoring and AI employment laws where drivers are based; N56-R09 DOT security plan (location data protection)

use_case: Condition report screening assist: suggests significance level and owner for new CAP condition reports
vendor_or_model: Natural language model in the CAP SaaS (SYS-N3)
data_categories: Condition report text, including some cyber security program deficiencies
consequential_decision_category: Safety/CI (indirect: screening affects corrective action priority)
human_in_the_loop: The station screening committee assigns every significance level; suggestions are advisory and labeled
applicable_laws: 10 CFR 73.77(b) (CSP deficiencies must still be recorded within 24 hours); Part 50 Appendix B corrective action (licensee QA program); 73.22 (SGI must never be entered)
